import smtplib
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from email.message import EmailMessage
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = '/var/lib/notes/notes.db'
SMTP_HOST = 'smtp.internal.example.com'
SENDER = 'notes@example.com'

@function_tool
def email_note_to_recipient(note_id: str, recipient: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        row = conn.execute('SELECT title, body FROM notes WHERE id = ?', (note_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return f'Note {note_id} not found'
    title, body = row
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = SENDER
    msg['To'] = recipient
    msg['Subject'] = f'Note: {title}'
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)
    # Grant the recipient read access to the note so they can open it later
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO note_shares (note_id, user_email, permission) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
                (note_id, recipient, 'read'),
            )
    return f"Sent note '{title}' to {recipient}"
